title: Vanilla Boosted
description:
This is the first version of vanilla boosted! It is also my first modpack. 

It is recommended to use this with the modrinth launcher so you do not have any mod conflicts.
body:
# 🌿 Vanilla Boosted

**The Minecraft experience you always wanted — no new content, just a better game.**

Vanilla Boosted is a carefully curated collection of performance optimizations and quality-of-life improvements that transform the way you play without ever touching the core game. No new biomes, no new mobs, no bloat — just Minecraft, running smoother and feeling smarter.

---

## ⚡ Performance

Say goodbye to lag spikes and stuttering. Vanilla Boosted includes the best-in-class performance mods to squeeze every frame out of your hardware:

- Significantly improved chunk loading and rendering
- Reduced memory usage and garbage collection pauses
- Better CPU and GPU utilization across all hardware
- Faster world generation and startup times

Whether you're on a high-end rig or a budget laptop, you'll notice the difference immediately.

---

## ✨ Quality of Life

All the small things that should've always been in the game:

- A cleaner, more informative HUD
- Better inventory management
- Smarter auto-saving and crash recovery
- Improved lighting, tooltips, and visual feedback
- Chat and UI enhancements that keep things readable
- And plenty more subtle improvements you'll wonder how you lived without

---

## 🍦 100% Vanilla-Friendly

Every mod in this pack is hand-picked to preserve the vanilla feel. No new items, no overhauls, no gameplay changes. Vanilla Boosted is the perfect pack for survival servers, vanilla playthroughs, or anyone who just wants a cleaner, faster game.

Compatible with vanilla servers — just install and play.

---
